# Constancy read at a member's class, and how what lies outside it is divided

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`constancy-read-at-a-members-class` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](constancy-read-at-a-members-class.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Constancy up to the net's end asked only at a member's class carries the path's laws and fails where a line ends while the net goes on; where the class holds the member's effects how what lies outside is divided is idle, and otherwise the split asks least.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Constancy up to the net's end asked only of the occurrences alike to a member is that condition at the member's class; constancy up to the net's end is that at every member's class. (`Becoming.«本类至终有常»`, `Becoming.«至终有常之逐类»`, `Becoming.«至终有常则本类至终有常»`)
2. Each law of the path that asks constancy up to the net's end holds at the member's class, and PF's and PF2's forms are its corollaries: what is alike to a member whose effects the class holds conditions only what is alike to it, everything downstream is on its line, what a line reaches it carries on, holding the effects is everything downstream being alike, and what leaves the class follows every alike step that goes on. (`Becoming.«出类不随则本类不至终有常»`, `Becoming.«本类出类随线»`, `Becoming.«本类出类随行»`, `Becoming.«本类常则闭当且仅当后皆同类»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭则后皆续»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭则所及皆及»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭则所缘同类»`)
3. A line that ends while it still conditions something fails the condition at its class; the organism's class fails it at the first member in both finite witnesses. (`Becoming.FiniteFamilies.member_class`, `Becoming.FiniteFamilies.member_not_constant_at`, `Becoming.FiniteSharedCondition.member_class`, `Becoming.FiniteSharedCondition.member_not_constant_at`, `Becoming.«亡而网续则本类不至终有常»`)
4. Where the class holds the effects of a member that conditions something, every class giving the member the same class gives the same verdict: how what lies outside is divided is idle. (`Becoming.«闭则外分无关»`)
5. Merging what lies outside keeps the condition, so where a predicate decides the member's class the split of that class from the rest asks least; under the split the condition is that what stays and what leaves follow every alike step that goes on. (`Becoming.«二分»`, `Becoming.«二分为类»`, `Becoming.«二分本类常当且仅当内外皆随»`, `Becoming.«外合不失本类之常»`, `Becoming.«异三则同»`, `Becoming.«本类之常至二分»`)
6. Dividing what lies outside more finely can break the condition; a witness where the split meets it without holding the member's effects. (`Becoming.FinerOutside.Occ`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.finer`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.finer_class`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.finer_not_constant_at`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.inClass`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.kind`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.not_held`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.same_class`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.split_constant_at`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.step`)
7. Constancy up to the net's end can fail under the split while the member's class keeps the condition and holds the member's effects, where alike occurrences outside differ in what they condition in it; a finer division is constant up to the net's end. (`Becoming.UnevenOutside.Occ`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.finer`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.finer_class`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.finer_constant_to_end`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.held`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.inClass`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.kind`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.same_class`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.split_constant_at`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.split_not_constant_to_end`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.step`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for every carrier, relation and class, the split given by a decided predicate; the witnesses' nets supplied, with discrete steps and equality on their carriers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That P2 should be read at one's own class, or with the split: that is argued as a reading, not proved.
- Which effects are one's own (the path's P4).
- That the steps of actual agents each leave something outside the class of their line (a correspondence).
- That the split is the only division worth reading: finer divisions sort effects by kind, which other questions may need.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

A correspondence: whether the steps of actual agents each leave something outside the class of their line, so that P2 read at one's own class passes a self drawn by intention in actual nets. The crux, P4, is put to philosophers.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Read with the path's P2: a self's regularity of its own is constancy up to the net's end at its own class. Under the split of oneself from the rest it asks of a self that holds its effects only that its line go on at every alike step that goes on, and of a self drawn by intention, besides, that something leave at every alike step that goes on wherever one does; the reading is the AI's.

- related, not a proved adapter: [what-leaves-a-class-follows-its-line](what-leaves-a-class-follows-its-line.md). Its laws are now corollaries of the forms at a member's class, and its next step (which class P2 reads, and a two-block characterization with the blocks given decidably) is answered here.
